name: Onion Powder
description: Dehydrated white onion, milled to a consistent grade for sauces, seasonings, snack coatings, and ready-meal manufacturing.
packaging: 25 kg multi-wall paper bag with PE liner
introduction: Lokavia's onion powder is a dehydrated, finely milled seasoning ingredient made from white onions sourced in Gujarat. It is primarily used in commercial food manufacturing, dry seasoning mixes, sauces, and ready-meals for uniform flavor distribution without adding moisture.

name: Garlic Powder
description: Steam-treated, low-temperature-dried garlic milled to a fine powder. Preserves sharp aroma and pungency for industrial seasoning use.
packaging: 25 kg multi-wall paper bag with PE liner
introduction: Lokavia's garlic powder is a low-temperature dehydrated, steam-sterilized seasoning powder processed from Indian garlic. It is widely used by food manufacturers and spice blenders to add deep aroma and sharp garlic flavor to marinades, coatings, and instant foods.

name: Ginger Powder
description: Cochin and Assam origin ginger, cleaned, dried, and pulverised. Warm, pungent aroma suitable for beverages, baked goods, and nutraceutical use.
packaging: 25 kg multi-wall paper bag with PE liner
introduction: Lokavia's ginger powder is a premium dehydrated spice powder milled from Cochin and Assam origin ginger. It serves as an aromatic, high-volatile-oil ingredient for industrial food processing, beverage manufacturing, baking, and health supplements.

name: Psyllium Husk
description: Psyllium (Plantago ovata) husk sourced from Gujarat. Available across 95%, 98%, and 99% purity grades for food, pharma, and supplement manufacturers.
packaging: 25 kg PP bag with PE liner
introduction: Lokavia's psyllium husk is a high-purity (up to 99%) natural dietary fiber processed from Plantago ovata seeds in Gujarat. It is primarily used by nutraceutical and supplement manufacturers as an active ingredient in digestive health, weight management, and fiber-supplement formulations.

variants.name: Psyllium Husk (Food-Grade)
variants.tagline: Clean, consistent binder and dietary fibre for food manufacturing.
variants.description: Food-grade psyllium husk and powder sourced from Gujarat agricultural belt, ideal as a natural stabilizer, binder, and fiber-enrichment ingredient in commercial baking, gluten-free formulations, and meat processing.

variants.introduction: Lokavia's food-grade psyllium husk is a clean, natural hydrocolloid binder and dietary fiber ingredient. It is used as a functional stabilizer and water-binding agent in commercial baking, gluten-free formulations, and processed food applications.
